summary: Build foresight, scenario design, and executive briefing skills in 5 days. Train with practical tools and apply them to real strategy challenges.
lede: Scenario planning and strategic foresight gives professionals a structured way to identify drivers of change, distinguish trends from critical uncertainties, and build plausible future scenarios. This course develops practical capabilities in horizon scanning, systems thinking, scenario design, implication mapping, and strategic prioritization. You will practice creating trend radars, scenario matrices, narratives, early warning indicators, and action roadmaps for use in planning cycles, risk reviews, innovation sprints, and executive workshops. The training also introduces AI-assisted signal scanning and digital collaboration workflows, helping turn weak signals into decision-ready insights for strategy reviews, resilience planning, and investment conversations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape strategy, manage uncertainty, and brief decision-makers on future risk and opportunity.
prerequisites: Participants should have experience in strategy, planning, risk, innovation, business analysis, or corporate performance roles. Prior exposure to basic strategic analysis, workshop facilitation, or planning documents is helpful. No coding is required, but a working understanding of spreadsheets, presentation tools, and collaborative digital workspaces will support the exercises. This is an advanced course delivered at an operational and application level, with some conceptual exposure to AI-assisted scanning and digital foresight tools.
